gems.note: You should default to Indecipherable Eversong Diamond as your unique Thalassian Diamond gem, as Midnight has very few other options. You may get more mileage out of simming yourself for a potential sub 1% gain, but you can't go wrong with these suggested gems.

consumables.note: Midnight expanded the array of oils and weapon enchants, but the power of most of them is middling at best. When you are fully geared, your choice of weapon imbuement will generally be Thalassian Phoenix Oil as a default for all content. The best Flask for San'layn is Flask of the Shattered Sun or Flask of the Blood Knights , depending on your current stats. As Deathbringer , the best flask will be either Flask of the Shattered Sun or Flask of Thalassian Resistance . You should sim yourself to identify which one it is; it will very likely come down to margin of error. Your default potion is Potion of Recklessness , with Light's Potential being slightly worse. In situations where you do not have to worry about performance, you can play Light's Potential if it is a lot cheaper to craft/buy. Do not get baited by Draught of Rampant Abandon . It provides slightly more strength than Light's Potential , but its downside-effect drops a 12 yard silence zone on you that persists until the potion is over. As a tank, one of your main responsibilities is positioning enemies, and there are very few things worse than an AoE denial that forces you to move at a moment's notice. You should use Concentrated Silvermoon Health Potion for in-combat healing. Healing potions do not share a cooldown with Healthstone s, so you can use both independently if you play with a Warlock. Feasts are the only food in Midnight to grant stamina alongside primary or secondary stats. Use Harandar Celebration (primary) or Blooming Feast (secondary stats); either option is fine and they provide comparable benefits to you, so it will likely be down to which feast your raid is placing. The personal food equivalents to both is Royal Roast (primary stat) or Champion's Bento (secondary stat). As mentioned, they are slightly worse due to not providing Stamina. Midnight brings with it a new augment rune, as is the custom for every expansion. For the entirety of the expansion, you will be using Void-Touched Augment Rune . Since these will be very limited in supply and thus quite expensive, we recommend getting the permanent Ethereal Augment Rune from K'aresh as a stopgap. It is a very small amount of primary stats, but it is more than zero in all of the cases where Void-Touched Augment Rune is out of financial reach. This guide has been written by Mandl and Panthea. Mandl is one of Acherus ' Useful Minions and an avid Blood Death Knight theorycrafter. Panthea raids in the Hall of Fame guild Catalyst . He plays all tanks and is a "Useful Minion" for the Acherus Death Knight Discord . You can follow him on Twitter .

These healing potions are great for when you need to quickly heal yourself, helping your healers, and ensuring that you stay alive. consumables.note: In current tuning Thalassian Phoenix Oil wins compared to other oils and Refulgent Whetstone both offensively and defensively. Midnight flasks come in four variants, one for each secondary stat. Vengeance prefers Flask of the Blood Knights for Haste, but if you are very heavy on Haste gear you can choose to use Flask of the Shattered Sun for Critical Strike or Flask of Thalassian Resistance for Versatility instead. When it comes to Combat potions the strongest option is currently Potion of Recklessness for a massive burst of your highest Secondary Stat, which is usually going to be Haste, at a small loss of your lowest Secondary Stat. This makes it a really strong potion for both burst damage and survivability while it is active. Midnight season 2 introduces a new Healing potion, Concentrated Silvermoon Health Potion , which heals for a larger amount than normal Healing potions making it a small upgrade. As a tank it will not restore a massive amount of your health, but it can still be useful in a pinch. There are plenty of food choices available in Midnight, but the food that currently looks to perform the best is one of the Main Stat Feasts such as Silvermoon Parade , and if that is not available you can use Royal Roast for yourself. consumables.note: Thalassian Phoenix Oil is the best temporary oil, but you will usually be using the Earthliving Weapon talent instead. You will generally want to be using Flask of the Shattered Sun in raids, as Critical Strike is a favored stat for all talent builds, while swapping to Flask of Thalassian Resistance in Mythic+ for its defensive benefits. Light's Potential is your best combat potion option, and should be paired with major cooldowns during moments of high group damage. You can also obtain Fleeting Light's Potential from Voidlight Potion Cauldron provided by Alchemists. Concentrated Silvermoon Health Potion is the current best healing potion, which should be used in emergencies or whenever you do not have the time to heal yourself. It does not share a cooldown with the combat potion, and using potions has a 5-minute cooldown, allowing you to use multiple in long encounters. While Mana-restoring potions do exist, they are very low value compared to Light's Potential , and therefore not worth using in almost all scenarios. You may want to keep a stack of them at hand for absolute emergencies, but it is generally better to simply use a stat-potion alongside your cooldowns. You should be eating from the Silvermoon Parade or Harandar Celebration feasts whenever possible, but can also use Royal Roast in solo and small group scenarios. Hearty versions of all foods can be created by the Cooking profession by combining 5 to 10 regular foods and, once eaten, provide their benefit for a full hour, even if you die midway through. Void-Touched Augment Rune grant a decent amount of Intellect and come from many sources, including NPC crafting orders for the various professions. As they tend to be very expensive for the stats granted, use these only in high-stakes situations! This guide has been written by Seksi , member of Cursed Gifts and healing aficionado.
